site.title: Tools SagalaIT
tagline: Semua berjalan di browser, data tidak dikirim ke server.
tagline_en: Everything runs in the browser, no data is sent to a server.

tools.name: Serialize Checker
tools.description: Cek dan betulkan string serialize
tools.description_en: Check and fix PHP serialize strings

tools.name: JSON Formatter
tools.description: Rapikan dan validasi JSON
tools.description_en: Format and validate JSON

tools.name: Hitung Byte
tools.description: Panjang string dalam byte dan karakter
tools.description_en: String length in bytes and characters

tools.name: Timer
tools.description: Hitung mundur dengan durasi dan suara pilihan
tools.description_en: Countdown with custom duration and sound

tools.name: Decoder JWT
tools.description: Baca isi token JWT dan periksa masa berlakunya
tools.description_en: Read the contents of a JWT and check its expiry

tools.name: Cron dan timer
tools.description: Buat, jelaskan, dan uji jadwal cron atau systemd timer
tools.description_en: Build, explain, and test cron schedules or systemd timers

tools.name: Nginx generator
tools.description: Buat konfigurasi server block: statis, reverse proxy, PHP-FPM
tools.description_en: Build server block configs: static, reverse proxy, PHP-FPM

tools.name: Database viewer
tools.description: Lihat data tabel dari CSV, JSON, atau dump SQL
tools.description_en: View table data from CSV, JSON, or SQL dumps

tools.name: Generator firewall
tools.description: Buat aturan firewall MikroTik atau Linux (nftables)
tools.description_en: Build MikroTik or Linux (nftables) firewall rules

tools.name: Roda acak
tools.description: Pilih acak dengan roda, bola undian, atau kartu menyala; bisa juga bagi grup
tools.description_en: Pick at random with a wheel, lottery balls, or flip cards; can also split groups

tools.name: Perintah database
tools.description: Susun perintah mysql, mysqldump, psql, dan pg_dump
tools.description_en: Compose mysql, mysqldump, psql, and pg_dump commands

tools.name: Pemasang PHP
tools.description: Susun perintah apt untuk PHP, paket, dan repo Ondřej
tools.description_en: Compose apt commands for PHP, packages, and the Ondřej repo

tools.name: Pembanding JSON
tools.description: Bandingkan dua JSON: key, nilai, tipe, dan panjang array
tools.description_en: Compare two JSON documents: keys, values, types, and array lengths

tools.name: Generator dokumentasi API
tools.description: Buat dokumen OpenAPI (Swagger) dari contoh request dan response
tools.description_en: Build an OpenAPI (Swagger) document from sample requests and responses

tools.name: Watermark
tools.description: Beri watermark pada foto KTP atau dokumen, diproses di browser
tools.description_en: Watermark ID card photos or documents, processed in the browser

tools.name: Konverter data
tools.description: Ubah JSON, array, object, serialize PHP, tabel, CSV, dan Excel satu sama lain
tools.description_en: Convert JSON, arrays, objects, PHP serialize, tables, CSV, and Excel to one another

tools.name: Pembuat tanda tangan
tools.description: Gambar tanda tangan, pilih latar transparan, putih, biru, atau warna lain, unduh PNG atau JPG
tools.description_en: Draw a signature, pick a transparent, white, blue, or custom background, download PNG or JPG

tools.description: Geser dan gabungkan ubin sampai 2048, papan 3×3 sampai 6×6, ada urungkan
tools.description_en: Slide and merge tiles up to 2048, boards from 3×3 to 6×6, with undo

tools.name: Sudoku
tools.description: Sudoku 9×9 empat tingkat dengan catatan pensil, petunjuk, dan pewaktu, soal berjawaban satu
tools.description_en: 9×9 Sudoku with four levels, pencil notes, hints, and a timer, every puzzle has one solution

tools.name: Generator kata sandi
tools.description: Buat sandi acak atau frasa sandi yang kuat, lengkap dengan entropi dan perkiraan waktu tebak
tools.description_en: Make strong random passwords or passphrases, with entropy and an estimated time to guess

tools.name: Penguji regex
tools.description: Uji ekspresi reguler: sorot kecocokan dan grup, ganti, pisah, dengan batas waktu anti backtracking
tools.description_en: Test regular expressions: highlight matches and groups, replace, split, with a backtracking time limit

tools.name: Kompres gambar
tools.description: Perkecil ukuran gambar: pilih format, kualitas, dan sisi terpanjang, bandingkan sebelum dan sesudah, unduh ZIP
tools.description_en: Shrink images: pick a format, quality, and longest side, compare before and after, download a ZIP

tools.name: Tebak kata
tools.description: Tebak kata bahasa Indonesia 5 huruf dalam 6 kesempatan, kata harian dan mode acak
tools.description_en: Guess a 5-letter Indonesian word in 6 tries, daily word and random mode

tools.name: Patungan (bagi tagihan)
tools.description: Bagi tagihan kafe per orang, termasuk harga berkoma, PPN, service, diskon, dan pembulatan
tools.description_en: Split a cafe bill per person, with decimal prices, VAT, service charge, discount, and rounding

tools.name: Terbilang rupiah
tools.description: Ubah angka jadi tulisan terbilang rupiah dan format Rp, bisa banyak angka sekaligus dan unduh CSV
tools.description_en: Turn numbers into Indonesian rupiah words and Rp format, in bulk with CSV download

tools.name: Kalkulator subnet
tools.description: Hitung jaringan IPv4 dari CIDR atau netmask, bagi subnet, periksa IP di jaringan, dan ringkas daftar CIDR
tools.description_en: Work out IPv4 networks from CIDR or netmask, split subnets, check an IP in a network, and summarize CIDR lists

tools.name: Konverter waktu
tools.description: Ubah Unix timestamp, ISO 8601, dan tanggal ke WIB, WITA, WIT, UTC, dan zona browser, plus jam hidup dan selisih dua waktu
tools.description_en: Convert Unix timestamps, ISO 8601, and dates to WIB, WITA, WIT, UTC, and your browser zone, with a live clock and time difference

tools.name: Penguji hash dan HMAC
tools.description: Hitung MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 dan HMAC dari teks atau berkas, cocokkan dengan hash yang diharapkan
tools.description_en: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and HMAC of text or a file, and match an expected hash

tools.name: Pembuat QR Code
tools.description: Buat QR Code dari tautan, teks, WiFi, kontak, email, SMS, telepon, WhatsApp, lokasi, atau acara, dengan warna dan logo, unduh PNG atau SVG
tools.description_en: Make a QR Code from a link, text, WiFi, contact, email, SMS, phone, WhatsApp, location, or event, with colors and a logo, download PNG or SVG

tools.name: Kalkulator tanggal
tools.description: Hitung selisih tanggal, tambah atau kurang hari, bulan, dan hari kerja (dengan libur nasional 2026), umur, dan hari dalam minggu
tools.description_en: Find the difference between dates, add or subtract days, months, and working days (with 2026 Indonesian holidays), age, and weekday

tools.name: Memory cards
tools.description: Cari pasangan kartu bergambar yang sama di papan 4×4, 4×5, atau 6×6, hitung langkah dan waktu, dengan rekor tiap papan
tools.description_en: Find matching picture card pairs on a 4×4, 4×5, or 6×6 board, with move and time counters and a record for each board

tools.name: Ketik cepat
tools.description: Uji kecepatan mengetik dengan mode waktu, kata, dan zen: WPM, akurasi, konsistensi, grafik per detik, rekor, dan riwayat tanpa akun
tools.description_en: Test your typing speed in time, words, or zen mode: WPM, accuracy, consistency, per-second chart, records, and history with no account

tools.name: Pembanding teks
tools.description: Bandingkan dua teks per baris atau per kata: baris ditambah, dihapus, dan kata yang berubah, tampilan sejajar atau satu kolom, salin sebagai diff
tools.description_en: Compare two texts by line or by word: added and removed lines, changed words, side-by-side or single-column view, copy as a diff

tools.name: Cek kontras warna
tools.description: Hitung rasio kontras WCAG 2.x warna teks dan latar (hex, rgb, hsl), lihat lulus AA dan AAA, dan dapatkan saran warna terdekat yang lulus
tools.description_en: Compute the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio of text and background colors (hex, rgb, hsl), see AA and AAA results, and get the nearest passing colors
